description: Réseaux en fibre optique jusqu'à l'abonné (FttH) - T3 2017 is a dataset listed in Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ARCEP. Suivi des déploiements sur le marché du haut et très haut débit fixes issu de la collecte trimestrielle "Observatoire de gros HD/THD" au titre de la décision n°2012-1503. Coverage: Dunkirk urban community. The portal files it under Numérique. Its keywords are FttH, Fibre, THD. The portal shows 17 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open License v1.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-dunkerque-agglo-fr-portal.
